predecessors.name: Kingdom of Italy
predecessors.text: the enclave in Rome that the Lateran Treaty 'recognised as an independent state under the sovereignty of the Holy See'

ledger.x: 11 February 1929: the Lateran Treaty creates Vatican City.

certainty.note: Fixed by the 1929 treaty; the German occupation of Rome after the September 1943 armistice and its liberation in 1944 respected Vatican City's neutral status (Vatican City page).
